text.p: Shares in Barclays Plc continued to slide on Wednesday in the wake of of lower-than-expected annual profits.
Dealers said that although broker comment on the stock had been mixed, investors were continuing to take profits after the shares' recent good run.
Barclays shares were 12p weaker at 11.17 stg by 1026 GMT. The shares fell 70p on Tuesday after the banking group announced its annual results.
"The mood about the results has not been too bad but the shares had come up strongly and they were ripe for a bit of profit-taking," one market-maker said.
Market sources said analysts at BZW had issued a "buy" recommendation on the stock, citing improving earnings quality and saying the shares were undervalued on a price/earnings basis.
